onboarding.title: Set up your agency
onboarding.languageHint: An Owner can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.currencyHint: All premiums, commissions and reports will show in this currency. An Owner can change it later in Settings; amounts are never converted, only relabelled.
onboarding.planHint: Plans are billed monthly in KES through Paystack (M-Pesa or card). Card payments in other currencies are converted by your bank.
onboarding.payRequired: Pay for your first period to open your agency. You can change plans later.

plans.for_starter: A solo agent or a small office getting started.
plans.for_growth: A growing agency with a team of agents.
plans.for_enterprise: An established agency with several branches or teams.
plans.for_enterprise_plus: A large agency or broker that needs no limits.
plans.f_clients: Clients and policies in one place
plans.f_commissions: Commission tracking and insurer statement matching
plans.f_receipts: Receipts by M-Pesa, bank or cheque
plans.f_payouts: Agent commission rates, earnings and payouts
plans.f_renewals: Renewal pipeline: contacted, quoted, renewed or lost
plans.f_team: Owner, Manager and Agent roles with invites
plans.f_languages: 6 languages and 4 currencies (KES, TZS, UGX, USD)

banner.askOwner: Ask your agency owner to renew.

banner.grace_other: The subscription has ended. {{count}} days left before access stops.

paywall.titleNew: Choose a plan to open your agency
paywall.bodyOwner: Pay to continue. Everything your agency entered is kept safe and is back as soon as the payment goes through.
paywall.bodyMember: Ask an Owner of your agency to renew. Your work is kept safe in the meantime.
paywall.downloadHint: Your clients and policies as CSV files, even before you pay.
